description:
## Goal
Complete watch-room UI: create/join rooms, HLS player synced to playback state, chat, reactions, reconnect.

## Scope
Room creation from movie detail, public list, invites, player, chat panel, 2-browser E2E test.

## Out of scope
Do not implement notifications bell or admin upload in this epic.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-441: Create room UI from movie detail (solo/private/public)
2. KIN-442: Public rooms list + join flow
3. KIN-443: Invite friend UI + copy invite URL
4. KIN-444: Participants list + owner permission controls
5. KIN-445: HLS player integrated with room playback state (owner/controller vs viewer)
6. KIN-446: Chat panel + reaction buttons in room page
7. KIN-447: Reconnect banner + wait for `room.state_sync` before local controls
8. KIN-448: E2E: 2-browser play/pause/seek/chat/reaction/reconnect test

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Reliable in-app notifications from RabbitMQ friendship and room-invite events with dedup and DLQ.

## Scope
Queue topology, consumer with manual ACK, dedup store, read API, Gateway routes, bell UI, tests.

## Out of scope
Do not implement push notifications or email in v1.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-501: RabbitMQ topology: exchange, queue, DLQ, bindings for friendship + room invite events
2. KIN-502: Consumer with manual ACK, 2 retries, DLQ on exhaustion
3. KIN-503: Dedup by `eventId` + in-app notifications store
4. KIN-504: `GET /notifications` + mark-as-read endpoint
5. KIN-505: Gateway routes + web notification bell UI
6. KIN-506: Tests: ACK timing, retry, DLQ, duplicate suppression

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Let admins upload large video files directly to MinIO via presigned multipart URLs, then enqueue transcode.

## Scope
Upload init/complete endpoints, abandoned cleanup, admin upload UI, tests.

## Out of scope
Do not implement FFmpeg transcoding or signed playback in this epic.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-511: `POST /admin/movies/:id/upload/init` — metadata first, presigned multipart URLs
2. KIN-512: `POST /admin/movies/:id/upload/complete` — finalize multipart, set PROCESSING, enqueue transcode
3. KIN-513: Abandoned upload cleanup job (24h)
4. KIN-514: Admin upload UI with direct-to-MinIO multipart + failed-part retry
5. KIN-515: Tests: metadata-first, presigned URLs, complete flow, abandoned cleanup

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Serve HLS only through short-lived signed URLs — never proxy video bytes through app services.

## Scope
`POST /movies/:id/media-access`, web player integration, security tests.

## Out of scope
Do not add DRM, multi-CDN, or a separate streaming service.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-531: `POST /movies/:id/media-access` — auth required, READY/PUBLISHED only, 10 min signed URL
2. KIN-532: Web player requests media-access before HLS load
3. KIN-533: Tests: unauthorized, expired URL, wrong state, successful playback
4. KIN-534: Verify app services never proxy video bytes

## Goal
Automated quality gate on every PR: lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, Playwright smoke.

## Scope
GitHub Actions workflow, Docker Compose in CI, artifact upload on failure.

## Out of scope
Do not deploy to production in this epic — CI only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-631: GitHub Actions: install, lint, typecheck, unit tests
2. KIN-632: CI: Docker Compose integration tests + Playwright smoke
3. KIN-633: Upload test artifacts on CI failure

## Goal
Make KinVue operable with Prometheus metrics on every service and Grafana dashboards.

## Scope
HTTP + WS metrics, Prometheus scrape config, Overview/Rooms/Media dashboards, observability runbook.

## Out of scope

## Suggested order
1. KIN-611: Prometheus metrics for all services (HTTP + Rooms WS metrics)
2. KIN-612: Grafana dashboards: Overview, Rooms, Media
3. KIN-613: Write `docs/runbooks/observability.md`

## Goal
Harden KinVue against common attacks: validation, CORS, rate limits, CI scanning, security tests.

## Scope
Body limits, CORS allowlist, secret/dependency scanning, security test suite, security runbook.

## Out of scope
Do not add new features — hardening only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-621: Input validation + body size limits on all external endpoints
2. KIN-622: CORS allowlist, secret scanning, dependency scanning in CI
3. KIN-623: Security tests: private room denial, viewer playback denial, admin guard, expired JWT, upload type denial
4. KIN-624: Write `docs/runbooks/security.md`

## Goal
Convert uploaded originals to multi-bitrate HLS in MinIO via FFmpeg and update movie status.

## Scope
Queue `media.transcode`, FFmpeg worker, internal callbacks, retry logic, fixture test.

## Out of scope
Do not build upload UI or signed URL playback in this epic.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-521: RabbitMQ queue `media.transcode` + job schema
2. KIN-522: FFmpeg worker: download original, generate HLS 1080p/720p/480p, upload to MinIO
3. KIN-523: Internal callbacks: transcode-complete → READY, transcode-failed → PROCESSING_FAILED
4. KIN-524: Retry up to 3 attempts before failure
5. KIN-525: Fixture video test: verify playable HLS output

## Goal
Let users schedule future watch sessions that auto-open Redis rooms and notify invitees.

## Scope
`scheduled_rooms` table, CRUD, scheduler, web UI, tests.

## Out of scope

## Suggested order
1. KIN-601: `scheduled_rooms` table + CRUD endpoints
2. KIN-602: Scheduler opens Redis room when due + emits invites
3. KIN-603: Schedule watch UI on movie detail + scheduled rooms page
4. KIN-604: Tests: create, cancel, due open, invitee notification

summary: Initialize git repo, add .gitignore, commit docs pack
description:
## What to do
Initialize the KinVue git repository at the project root: create `.gitignore`, commit the existing documentation pack, and push to `main`. This preserves the architecture docs and implementation plan before any application code lands.

## Technical notes
- Commands: `git init`, `git branch -M main`, commit docs pack before app code
- See Phase 0 in `27_MAIN_STEP_BY_STEP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`
- Labels: docs

## Story points
1

## Depends on
KIN-1

## Acceptance criteria
- Git repo initialized on `main` branch
- `.gitignore` covers node_modules, dist, .env, coverage
- Documentation pack committed

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md
- 27_MAIN_STEP_BY_STEP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

summary: Bootstrap pnpm + Turbo monorepo with root scripts
description:
## What to do
Set up the pnpm + Turbo monorepo skeleton at the repo root with workspace scripts `dev`, `build`, `test`, `lint`, and `typecheck`. Every KinVue app and package will live inside this workspace, so getting the structure right now prevents rework later.

## Technical notes
- Root scripts: `dev`, `build`, `test`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `infra:up`
- Files: `package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `turbo.json`
- Labels: infra

## Story points
2

## Depends on
KIN-2

## Acceptance criteria
- `pnpm install` succeeds
- `pnpm build` runs (even if apps are empty stubs)
- Workspace includes `apps/*`, `packages/*`, `tests/*`
- Root scripts: dev, build, test, lint, typecheck

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md
- 27_MAIN_STEP_BY_STEP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

summary: Add strict root TypeScript + Prettier config
description:
## What to do
Add strict shared TypeScript and Prettier configuration at the monorepo root (`tsconfig.base.json`, `.prettierrc`). All services and packages inherit these settings for consistent type-checking and formatting.

## Technical notes
- Files: `tsconfig.base.json`, `.prettierrc` at repo root
- Labels: infra

## Story points
1

## Depends on
KIN-3

## Acceptance criteria
- `tsconfig.base.json` with strict TypeScript settings
- `.prettierrc` configured
- `pnpm typecheck` passes

- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md
- 27_MAIN_STEP_BY_STEP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
